shore.line: Grey water, and no far side to it.

study.say: The stone is warm where nothing else is. A mark is cut into the top of it, deep enough to read with your thumb.

read.say: The marks hold still. They are names in a line, all walking the same way.

read.refuse: The marks swim. You cannot hold them.

objects.name: a book, face up in the shingle

look.say: The pool is shallow and clear. Your face does not arrive in it.

listen.say: You hold still and listen. There is your breath, and the water, and nothing under either.

follow.say: The path climbs off the shingle and inland. It runs the way the names run in the book.

follow.refuse: The path goes up into the dark. You have no name for what is at the top of it.
